summary: AI2Bharat (/home/user/ai2bharat) is a bilingual EN/HI community platform (plus 19 MT locales). It teaches Indians AI human-feedback work through a Learning Studio (21 pathways, 164 lessons, 46 quests, 42 rubrics on main) and an AI learning guide, Saathi. Saathi uses telegraphic CORE prompt rows, two appended-last MUST slots, code output gates, a six-kind memory with no affect stored, and voice as input only. Every number in context/ carries n, method and date. Round 21 ran eight parallel branches, all forked from 2c82d28 (the exemplar contract). E0/E1/E2 publish 11 worked exemplars beside quest rubrics. Each is a reference artefact at a stated standard, beside a competent-but-hurried weaker one, with Met/Partly/Not-met margin notes that point at lines and never carry a number. A 17-test gate enforces them: strong all met; weaker never all-met and never all-not-met; notes of at least 8 words that never restate the rule; weaker body of at least 60 words; no sentence over 20 words; EN/HI parity; vocabulary lock; no names or money; a fingerprint pinned to a date. M3 adds the multimodal pathway's top rung (judge generated media in 4 buckets, write a robotics scenario, adapt a rubric tested by two raters twice). M1 makes the money lessons concrete (GST zero-rating, the presumptive half, payment rails, a dated pay reading). M2 adds one real open-model run with values, a real trace record, and a pairwise rubric. F1 fixes three measured shell residues: a height-gated rail, a hidden closed disclosure, and an arithmetic-chosen 16-icon sprite (112,932 to 107,772 B, render 45 to 20 ms; an all-35 sprite was larger and rejected). M4 replaced 22 homepage-only sources, printed the ladder feed block from a dated listings-only snapshot (172 listings; the typed '~1,000' was 5.8x wrong), and dropped content-safety. KEY FINDING: the M4 squash merge 6986880 carried 1 of 40 files. Main still has 22 bare-root sources and the stale feed sentence, yet context/measurements.md logs '22 -> 0', and main's gates pass because the guarding test was lost too. Across Rounds 1-21 the measured lessons most useful to Taxila are: (1) near-miss MCQs, whose distractors are wrong applications of the same rule in the same scene (retired stems 70% to 0, borrowed distractors 99% to 0); (2) criteria read only from taught lesson lines; (3) Cohen's kappa with Wilson and FCE intervals, plus the high-agreement/zero-kappa artefact seen live (kappa <= 0 in 13/19 locales at a 92.5% median agreement); (4) question share. Every model ended 67-87% of turns with a question. A bounded slot cut grok to about 43%. A clause inside the slot made it worse (48.3%). A scoped code question-trim gate reached 23-26% at n=320 twice. (5) A prompt rule leaks while a code predicate does not; (6) D-057 no-affect storage and D-061 no live voice calls (until byte-identical CORE on realtime), both of which constrain Taxila's emotional OS and realtime plans.

assets.title: Quest exemplar contract
assets.what: Typed shape for a worked exemplar beside a 3-rule rubric: brief, standard, strong and weaker sides as EN/HI paragraphs, three margin notes per side keyed to rubric criterion ids, marks met/partly/not-met as words, takeaway, authoredOn, a single EXEMPLAR_BOUNDARY sentence ('a reference, not an answer; nobody is compared'). The header lists 10 rules
assets.taxila_target: Self-check exemplars for child work and parent view (a model answer beside a plausible weaker one, with line-pointing notes)
assets.evidence: 11 exemplars published; 17/17 gate tests pass on main (run 2026-10-02)

assets.title: Exemplar gate (17 tests)
assets.what: Ten contract rules plus integrity and surface tests: rubric id/version live; notes in rubric order; strong all met, weaker never all-met and never all-not-met; note of at least 8 words that never contains the rule text; weaker body of at least 60 words; sentences of at most 20 words; EN/HI parity and a Latin-word rule whose allow-list is parsed from one file; banned-word lock; no honorific+name, @handle, Work-list company or money regex; FNV-1a fingerprint pinned to authoredOn; brief must not equal any lesson string
assets.taxila_target: Gate for authored or LLM-generated exemplar pairs in lessons

assets.title: Eleven exemplar content files
assets.what: Authored exemplar pairs. The weaker side is a competent hurried attempt (categories instead of cases; refuses correctly, then reads the assistant's answer aloud anyway)
assets.notes: Domain is AI-work; reuse the authoring pattern, not the content

assets.title: Exemplar rendering on rubric page
assets.what: EN then HI per paragraph. Margin notes sit under paragraphs on phones and beside them from 760px. Light and dark mark chips. One link per index row, with a chip inside it. The work-sample lesson links to the rules and says when a worked example exists

assets.title: Quest rubrics read from lesson lines, with fingerprint and notGradeable rule
assets.what: Each criterion is read at module load from the quest's own lessons (a concept line or the artifact hint), so no untaught criterion can exist; it throws loudly on a missing source. criteriaFingerprint (FNV-1a) pins the text and a change requires a new version. Framed 0/3/5 anchors, with a measured reversal to hand-written anchors if kappa < 0.6. notGradeable when judging requires seeing another named person. questRubricCoverage measures gate 1
assets.taxila_target: Covert comprehension criteria limited to what was taught in-session

assets.title: Calibration arithmetic: Cohen's kappa, Wilson, FCE kappa CI, verdict floors
assets.what: cohensKappa over a fixed category list, returning null with a reason (no-pairs, no-variation). Wilson interval for agreement. Fleiss-Cohen-Everitt asymptotic kappa CI, clamped, with a largeSample flag below 30 pairs. calibrationNumberVerdict floors: 90% agreement, kappa >= 0.6 on every criterion, at least 20 items. A self-test runs on 5 known fixtures. publishedCalibrationSets is kept empty on purpose
assets.taxila_target: Agreement between the LLM comprehension judge and teachers, between judges, and in parent-report QA
assets.evidence: 5/5 fixtures incl. Cohen's 2x2 kappa=0.400 (2026-09-01); used for the 760-unit translation judging

assets.title: Near-miss check authoring rule
assets.what: The prompt is a scene from the learner's life (8-25 words, no distinctive answer word). The answer is the lesson's own rule. Two distractors are plausible wrong applications of the same rule in the same scene, using three shapes: right rule wrong step / right rule wrong source / right rule half applied. The rationale names each near-miss by position and never the answer. The rules are hidden behind a disclosure until the check is answered
assets.taxila_target: Shape of every generated MCQ and of misconception probes in covert comprehension
assets.evidence: 100 lessons: retired stem 70% to 0, borrowed-rule distractor 99% to 0 (13 Sep 2026)

assets.title: Near-miss gate counters
assets.what: Exported contentWords (EN/HI stop lists, danda excluded), distinctiveWords (6+ base letters; Hindi counted without matras), answerOverlap, sceneWordCount, and nearMissFailures(). They check retired stems, scene length, a scene giving away the answer, distractor overlap >= 60%, a distractor equal to or paraphrasing (>= 60%) any catalog bullet, a rationale longer than 60 chars, Hindi parity and Devanagari. Negative controls run against the real pre-change objects
assets.taxila_target: Pre-display gate for LLM-generated quiz items and module checks

assets.title: Lesson and module schema
assets.what: LearningLesson {outcome, why, concepts[3], workedExample{brief,weak,strong,reviewerNote}, artifactPrompt, artifactHint, conceptCheck, transferCheck, checkStyle}. LearningModule {level, prerequisiteLevel, sourceProvider/Url, evidenceArtifact, practice{scenario, options, correctIndex, rationale}, draft?, newSince?}. LearningQuest {moduleIds 3-5 consecutive, prepares[]}. Records store option indexes (smallint), never answer text
assets.taxila_target: Taxila lesson/module data model plus NCERT chapter ids, age band and modality variants

assets.title: Five-rung content ladder and quests
assets.what: Shuruaat/Buniyaad/Kaam/Mahir/Ustaad are levels of content, never people. Quests tile each pathway exactly and end in a work sample. prepares may be empty on purpose. Nothing is locked. levelLessonCount vs levelQuestBandLessonCount, with the reconciliation identity questBand = lessons - carriedOut + carriedIn held by test
assets.taxila_target: Week-sized finishable units per chapter; no 'you are level X'

assets.title: Generated doc blocks and the feed-snapshot printer
assets.what: BEGIN/END GENERATED blocks printed from the catalog. A test fails if prose types a count. M4 adds --fetch to write a dated listings-only snapshot (5 fields, key set asserted) and a printed demand table
assets.taxila_target: Syllabus coverage tables printed from dated NCERT/CBSE snapshots
assets.notes: The feed mode exists only on r21/m4; it was lost in the main merge

assets.title: Demand-to-curriculum mapping snapshot
assets.what: 172 listings by family beside the number of quests preparing for each. Exposed domain-expert 82/12, software-research 1/13, content-safety 0 listings while 5 quests claimed it
assets.taxila_target: Board-exam weightage and misconception frequency vs Taxila coverage

assets.title: Shared plain-English sentence splitter
assets.what: One splitter and word counter (MAX_WORDS=20, steps over decimals and initials, dash joins nothing), shared by every reading-level gate so the instruments cannot disagree
assets.taxila_target: Reading-level gate per class band (tune the ceiling by age)

assets.title: Hindi Latin-word rule and glossary
assets.what: No Latin tokens inside Hindi strings except an allow-list. Other gates parse the list out of this one file. The screen-term rule and a register glossary; 287 Hindi strings were rewritten by a register reviewer
assets.taxila_target: Hindi/Hinglish register policy aligned with NCERT Hindi-medium terminology

assets.title: Tiered vocabulary lock
assets.what: findBannedEvidenceWords(copy, tier). Promise words (certificate, guarantee, degree, licence, Hindi equivalents) are banned per tier. Latin terms match on word boundaries, Devanagari as substrings
assets.taxila_target: Ban test-like words in covert-comprehension turns and promise words in parent reports

assets.title: Document fingerprint pins
assets.what: FNV-1a over every string, pinned with authoredOn. An edit without a new date or version fails the build, and the failure prints the exact pin line
assets.taxila_target: Pin published lessons, rubrics, consent text and parent-report templates

assets.title: Shrink-only dated allowlist
assets.what: The gate fires for everything. Known offenders are named with the measured date, fixed entries must be removed, and nothing may be added (the count is frozen)

assets.title: Saathi pedagogy CORE (telegraphic rows, two appended-last slots)
assets.what: Identity, register, pedagogy, celebration, refused and safety-floor rows written as shapes. firstMoveOnDoubt, explanationOrder, doubtEscalationLadder, onWrongAttempt, onCorrectAttempt, afterAFeeling, comprehension-tag ban. Exactly two MUST slots: never give a checked-step answer (one hint rung per turn), and ask before telling / close on a statement. CORE 8,000 B cap with 10% headroom, TAIL 6,000 B. The budget test asserts every module x stage x locale
assets.taxila_target: Taxila teacher CORE; kid-specific inversions need owner decisions

assets.title: Output gates including scoped question-trim, with a shared predicate
assets.what: Gates: empty, leaked answer, verdict shape, register/provenance, emoji (closed 8-glyph set, affection fatal), whole-reply cut-off, and question-trim for define-a-word and give-a-hint only. Discard, never edit; fall back to authored Phase A. The gate and the eval import one naive endsInQuestion
assets.taxila_target: Text-turn gates and post-transcript checks for realtime turns
assets.evidence: Question share 42.7% to 23.2%/25.8% at n=320 twice (2026-09-13)

assets.title: Register battery
assets.what: Authored and model arms; the model arm is reported NOT RUN without a paid lane. 290 distinct prompts + 30 repeats = n=320. Per-intent word bands (doubt 20/32, ask 20/32, hint 24/40, define 30/55, explain 55/95, refusal 26/45), question share overall and per band (ceiling 0.35), emoji/script/em-dash rates, gate-trip rate beside the register table, cached tokens, cost per turn
assets.taxila_target: Teacher register battery per model and per lane (text and realtime) before any flag flip

assets.title: Closed six-kind memory, never-store affect, hard-delete forgetting
assets.what: Kinds: weak topic, misconception, explanation style, goal, context given, term asked. Closed in TS, a DB CHECK and a test. Only two sources: an explicit statement in the learner's own words, or a recorded event. No affect stored (value filter + DB constraint). Forgetting is a hard delete plus a forget term; no deleted_at; 'ye bhool jao' is acted on before render; with memory off the prompt is byte-identical
assets.taxila_target: Learning-profile kinds (explanation style, misconception); the no-affect rule conflicts with Taxila's emotional OS and needs an owner decision

assets.title: Paid-lane data-terms assertion and byte-identical prompt digest
assets.what: The provider is refused unless MODEL_LANE_DATA_TERMS=paid and a terms record exists (URL, read date, paidTierTrainingUse=false). Each lane re-reads CORE+TAIL from the serialized wire body; a digest mismatch is a prompt-fork discard
assets.taxila_target: Minors' data under DPDP; realtime session-instruction byte check (the D-061 reversal condition)
assets.evidence: 0 prompt forks across every n=320 run

assets.title: Feature router with DB-backed daily caps
assets.what: No feature calls a model directly. Feature maps to an env-named deployment. A daily USD cap per feature from a DB ledger fails closed to authored content

assets.title: Criterion-named AI feedback with no verdict
assets.what: 2-4 items. The criterion must be one of the lesson's own lines (the authored text is served). No verdict or score-like number. At most 40 generated words, and no run of more than 15 consecutive words found in neither the draft nor the lesson (an answer-leak test). Nothing stored
assets.taxila_target: Feedback on a child's spoken or written explanation without grading
assets.evidence: Pass rate 71.9% to 89.1% EN / 87.5% romanized Hindi, n=64 per arm (13 Sep)

assets.title: Spaced retrieval with structural no-guilt
assets.what: Intervals of 2/7/21/60 days over finished modules. No skipped/streak/seenAt/dueSince fields; rescheduleMissed moves dates forward; the surface type carries no date; the card is absent when nothing is due; no notification path. Four-question NEVER MANIPULATE audit in the header
assets.taxila_target: Cross-session concept revisits by the teacher

assets.title: NEVER MANIPULATE audit and level floor
assets.what: Every mechanic answers four questions (decay, nag, compare, reward only inspectable work). levelFloor: growth never demotes. Milestones live in an append-only ledger

assets.title: Build-time lesson translation pipeline
assets.what: Per-unit cache keyed by a per-module source hash. Structural checks: options and correctIndex never translated, target-script ratio, placeholders, echo refusal. A failing unit falls back to English as a recorded gap; changed source becomes a source-changed gap
assets.taxila_target: Regional-language lesson packs

assets.title: Translation quality probe with two non-translating judges
assets.what: Adequacy and fluency 1-5, stratified by seed, two judges, kappa via A06

assets.title: Responsive audit harness
assets.what: 10 checks plus RTL over 35 surfaces x 18 viewports x en/hi/ur x light/dark = 2,912 cells; a check it cannot measure reports 'unmeasured'
assets.taxila_target: Web and Capacitor surfaces for Taxila
assets.evidence: Distinct defects 1,170 to 439 over 5 production runs (13 Sep)

assets.title: Arithmetic-chosen icon sprite and height-gated rail
assets.what: Only icons drawn at least twice on every page go in the sprite (symbol cost ~20 B plus geometry; use ~140 B). <use> references Phosphor's own <svg> elements. The rail rule is gated at min-height 930px. The closed disclosure gets visibility:hidden

assets.title: Four-bucket generated-media fault taxonomy
assets.what: Buckets: asked (prompt word missed), artefact (no camera would show it), style across the set, fit for the place (a cultural mismatch drawn cleanly, e.g. a mangalsutra drawn as a plain chain, snow on a Diwali rooftop). Each routes to a different fix. Built from the RichHF, BEHAVIOR-1K and RoboArena papers
assets.taxila_target: QA rubric for gpt-image-2 lesson images and generated modules for Indian children

assets.title: Dated fact table kept out of lesson strings
assets.what: Facts as {claim en/hi, statedBy, sourceName, sourceUrl, sourceKind, checkedOn, assumption}. A dated reading (31/172 listings stated a rate) lives here, not in lessons, because of the no-figure gate
assets.taxila_target: Curriculum fact table with NCERT page refs and checked dates

assets.title: Depth review, accuracy and Hindi-sample protocol
assets.what: Each pathway scored 1-5 on whether a working professional recognises something real at the top rung. Every source curled. Checkable facts verified against the live feed. 20 lessons read in Hindi on an A/B/C scale. A ranked backlog ordered by (listings x depth / effort). Also benchmarks against the best courses (Google rater guidelines, MQM, Carpentries)
assets.taxila_target: Review protocol for generated modules: would a good CBSE class-N teacher recognise it as correct and age-right

assets.title: bol Indic behaviour benchmark design
assets.what: Items only by revocable post-completion donation. No gamification, no composite score. n + CI beside the human ceiling. Answer-position balance audited (always-A scores 50%). Public predicates are the same bytes the product gates on
assets.taxila_target: Hinglish kid-tutor behaviour benchmark from consented sessions

assets.title: Server-side stage gate
assets.what: Refuses on stage as well as intent, so a client cannot obtain a checked step's answer. Photos are withheld from the model on checked steps
assets.taxila_target: Never leak the answer to an in-flight comprehension probe

assets.title: Evidence states ladder
assets.what: Exposed, Practised, Calibrated, Reviewed, Published. Only the first three are automatable. Reviewed is held off until rubrics, calibration and a named owner exist
assets.taxila_target: Per-concept comprehension state per child (heard, attempted, explained back, transferred, parent-visible)

assets.title: Honorific arc and name-use rules as state
assets.what: aap to tum by lifetime turn count; tu unreachable by type. Name used about 1 turn in 5, never in a correction or refusal, never twice per turn; enforced by the output gate
assets.taxila_target: Teacher warmth arc in the relational OS

rejections.what_broke: n=80 pilots pointed the wrong way twice; 'close on the next move' gave 64.2%; 'every turn closes on a statement' pushed doubt-support out of band

rejections.tried: Mid-CORE rows to stop re-asking at the close
rejections.what_broke: No detectable effect (47.0 vs 44.7, n=320); reverted

rejections.tried: A fourth clause inside slot 2 naming the two worst bands
rejections.what_broke: The aggregate rose 42.7% to 48.3%; untargeted bands regressed (ask 35 to 64%, doubt 28 to 45%); reverted
rejections.taxila_relevance: Clause order inside a must-fire rule is mechanism; use scoped code gates instead

rejections.tried: A gate discarding every question-ending reply
rejections.what_broke: It would discard two turns in three; replaced by a trim scoped to two intents

rejections.tried: A third appended-last slot
rejections.what_broke: It dilutes the two slots that must fire; capped at exactly 2 by test

rejections.tried: Enforcing the emoji vocabulary only as a prompt row
rejections.what_broke: 2.2% off-vocabulary and affection glyphs leaked; it became two fatal gates

rejections.tried: Deliberate typos for liveness (ported from the companion)
rejections.what_broke: A typo in a technical term is a teaching error; banned, liveness bought with rhythm and shortforms

rejections.tried: Companion traits (affection emoji, face, backstory, openers, re-engagement, reactions on work)
rejections.what_broke: Inverted for a tutor serving minors with no age verification; a tick on work is a verdict with no words
rejections.taxila_relevance: Taxila wants a persona and avatar; keep the affection, re-engagement and verdict bans for children

rejections.tried: Storing affect in learner memory
rejections.what_broke: It is an unreviewed durable judgement, cannot be shown honestly on a privacy screen, and is not needed to teach; refused in code and a DB CHECK (D-057)
rejections.taxila_relevance: Directly constrains Taxila's emotional OS; owner decision plus DPDP review needed

rejections.tried: Soft delete for forgetting
rejections.what_broke: The row is re-learned the next turn from the conversation, and deleted_at invites wrong filters; replaced by hard delete plus a forget term (D-058)

rejections.tried: Auto-sending voice transcripts
rejections.what_broke: At 32-52% CER on Hinglish the guide confidently answers a different question; transcript-to-box only (D-059)
rejections.taxila_relevance: Taxila's realtime voice must surface misheard words back to the child

rejections.tried: webkitSpeechRecognition as a silent fallback
rejections.what_broke: Poor on Hinglish, and an unlabelled bad lane is worse than none (D-060)

rejections.tried: Live voice calls with the tutor
rejections.what_broke: Cascade floor about 1.4-1.5 s, and a realtime lane twice dropped rules the text lane keeps (safety, recall); declined until the realtime lane accepts byte-identical CORE (D-061)
rejections.taxila_relevance: Taxila's gpt-realtime plan must meet this reversal condition with a byte-identity assertion and a realtime register battery

rejections.tried: A cloned human voice for the tutor
rejections.what_broke: Refused as a claim of personhood

rejections.tried: DeepSeek-V4-Flash as the tutor lane
rejections.what_broke: 58-71% lane failures, 4-5/5 word bands out, and a fabricated image description

rejections.tried: gpt-4.1-mini as the tutor lane
rejections.what_broke: Question share 75-87%, a give-a-hint band failure, and 2.2x the cost of grok

rejections.tried: Unpaid Gemini keys for learner content
rejections.what_broke: Terms allow training use and human review of minors' content, plus an 8/19 fuse-hit latency tail; replaced by a paid-lane assertion (D-068)

rejections.tried: A 128-token thinking budget inside a 320-token answer envelope
rejections.what_broke: Gemini ignored the budget and served mid-word fragments; fixed with a cut-off gate plus a 640 budget outside the answer allowance

rejections.tried: A code comment asserting '~9x cheaper, ~90% cache hit'
rejections.what_broke: Never measured; deleted and instrumented. Inflating CORE to reach a cache floor was refused

rejections.tried: A case-insensitive option-letter regex in the feedback and stage gates
rejections.what_broke: It matched the article 'a' and discarded 1 in 4 feedback replies

rejections.tried: Text normalisers that drop \p{M}

rejections.tried: Emitting 'signin_google succeeded' at redirect start

rejections.tried: Counting words and tap targets inside closed <details>
rejections.what_broke: Overstated word counts (141 vs 123) and phantom 42.68px targets; use checkVisibility()

rejections.tried: Following 'cut text, fewer boxes' literally (Round 5)

rejections.tried: A Suspense boundary alone to speed Today's paint

rejections.tried: Each content agent moving count pins and writing union migrations

concepts.name: Exemplar beside the rubric (the missing middle)
concepts.description: Grading nothing leaves learners unable to judge their own work. Publish a reference at a stated standard beside a competent-but-hurried weaker attempt for the same brief, with margin notes that point at lines and marks that are words
concepts.taxila_relevance: The non-test way to teach standards to children; parents see the same pair

concepts.name: The weaker side is an attempt, never an absence
concepts.description: Enforced: never all-not-met, a body of at least 60 words, a visible method
concepts.taxila_relevance: Generated 'wrong' examples must be real age-typical misconceptions

concepts.name: Criteria are lesson lines
concepts.description: A rubric criterion is read from taught content: one copy, fingerprinted, versioned
concepts.taxila_relevance: Covert comprehension judges only against what the teacher actually taught

concepts.name: notGradeable is a real answer
concepts.description: If judging requires seeing what another person did, no rubric exists, only a written reason
concepts.taxila_relevance: Parent reports never claim unobservable things

concepts.name: Near-miss distractors
concepts.description: Wrong applications of the same rule in the same scene: wrong step, wrong source, half applied. The scene must not give away the answer, and the rationale explains each failure here
concepts.taxila_relevance: Shape of misconception probes in covert comprehension

concepts.name: The screen is half the defect
concepts.description: An answer printed above its question defeats any content rule
concepts.taxila_relevance: Generated modules must not render the key sentence beside its check

concepts.name: Levels of content, never of people
concepts.description: Five rungs label lessons, quests are week-sized finishable units, and milestones come only from finished work
concepts.taxila_relevance: Never tell a child 'you are level 3'

concepts.name: NEVER MANIPULATE four-question audit
concepts.description: Decay, nag, compare, reward-only-inspectable-work, enforced structurally by types with no streak/missed fields
concepts.taxila_relevance: Children are the most manipulable users; port the audit to every mechanic

concepts.name: Celebrate events, never quality
concepts.description: Celebration is licensed only by a recorded moment; ability praise is banned; method is named
concepts.taxila_relevance: Growth-mindset praise for children

concepts.name: Position is mechanism; shapes not sentences
concepts.description: Two appended-last MUST slots; clause order inside a slot measurably matters; sentence-shaped prompt text gets recited
concepts.taxila_relevance: Teacher CORE and realtime instructions need the same discipline, measured on the realtime model

concepts.name: Prompt preference vs code invariant
concepts.description: Rules that matter are code predicates over output; discard, never edit; an authored fallback always exists
concepts.taxila_relevance: Every child-safety rule needs a transcript/text gate and a fallback utterance

concepts.name: Shared naive predicate between gate and eval
concepts.description: The gate and the measurement import the same function so they cannot disagree
concepts.taxila_relevance: Comprehension-signal extractors identical in eval and production

concepts.name: Measurement discipline
concepts.description: n, method and date on every number; a stochastic result is a band, not a point; a gate-trip row beside gated properties; the per-model law; NOT RUN instead of approximation
concepts.taxila_relevance: Taxila's context/measurements must follow this

concepts.name: High agreement, zero kappa
concepts.description: Skewed marginals give high percent agreement with kappa near or below 0 (seen live in 13/19 locales)
concepts.taxila_relevance: Validate an LLM comprehension judge vs teachers with kappa and Wilson/FCE CIs

concepts.name: Generated docs from data; dated snapshots
concepts.description: Never type a count or market fact; print it from data with a date
concepts.taxila_relevance: Syllabus coverage tables from dated NCERT snapshots

concepts.name: Demand-to-curriculum mapping
concepts.description: Listings per family beside quests preparing for it expose over- and under-coverage
concepts.taxila_relevance: Map exam weightage and misconception frequency against lesson coverage

concepts.name: Shrink-only dated allowlist
concepts.description: The gate is real for all; known offenders are named, dated and only removable
concepts.taxila_relevance: Grandfather legacy generated content honestly

concepts.name: A document has a date
concepts.description: A fingerprint pinned to authoredOn or version; edits require a new date
concepts.taxila_relevance: Lessons, rubrics, consent text, parent-report templates

concepts.name: No-affect memory (D-057)
concepts.description: Affect is read per turn and never stored, because a stored affect row is an unreviewed judgement that cannot be shown honestly
concepts.taxila_relevance: Tension with Taxila's emotional OS. Adopt the 'show every row in its stored words' test; persisted affect needs owner sign-off, DPDP review for minors and parent visibility

concepts.name: Closed memory kinds, two sources, hard-delete forgetting
concepts.description: Kinds closed in an enum, a DB CHECK and a test; only stated or recorded-event sources; forget = hard delete plus forget term
concepts.taxila_relevance: Learning-profile memory (explanation style, misconception, weak topic)

concepts.name: Honorific as state, not mood
concepts.description: The address-register arc is driven by turn counts and typed so forbidden forms are unreachable
concepts.taxila_relevance: Teacher warmth arc in the relational OS

concepts.name: Paid-lane terms assertion plus byte-identical prompt digest
concepts.description: Learner content only goes to lanes with recorded no-training terms; the prompt on the wire is proven identical to the compiled one
concepts.taxila_relevance: Minors' data; the realtime-lane reversal condition

concepts.name: Merge verification by content
concepts.description: The M4 squash dropped 39/40 files under a claimful message, and measurements were then logged against code not on main
concepts.taxila_relevance: Taxila's multi-workstream builds must diff merged trees against branch deltas

concepts.name: Arithmetic-chosen optimisation; gate on the varying dimension
concepts.description: Sprite membership is chosen by byte arithmetic; the layout rule is gated on height, which is what actually varied
concepts.taxila_relevance: Measure before optimising Taxila's UI

concepts.name: Depth review: would a professional recognise it
concepts.description: A 1-5 depth rubric needing procedure, numbers, a named failure mode and a document convention
concepts.taxila_relevance: Review generated modules as a good class-N teacher would
